name: @gamecrate/cli
description: Run a modded game in a container, with mods resolved from your local checkouts.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:types && npm run build:binary
scripts.build:node: bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --packages=external --define __VERSION__='"'${npm_package_version:-0.0.0-dev}'"' --outfile dist/gamecrate.js && bun build ./src/lib.ts --target=node --packages=external --outfile dist/lib.js
scripts.prepare: npm run build:node && npm run build:types
scripts.prepack: npm run build:node && npm run build:types
